items.message: _workflow_ids relies on a regex over register()'s source to enumerate ids, but the diff does more than it says in one direction.

_workflow_function uses a second, tighter regex to map an id to a function name; a reformatting that splits the decorator call across lines would cause show-workflow <id> to raise ClickException for an id the listing just advertised.
show-workflow --registered changes working directory implicitly via _default_lockstep(); the diff does not show what that function does.
The listing path (no name, no --registered) hard-codes only 'implement' and 'fix' as families.
